label: Worldwise deletion attacks the necessary concretum at the selected world
note: Target: b19ffd92 (some concrete individual exists at w and at every world accessible from w), on the root routes. Mechanism: read on the same Ontic and concreteness predicate, worldwise deletion at the selected world w gives, for any concrete individual existing at w, an accessible world lacking it, which contradicts b19ffd92 at w directly (DeletionAt at w applied to its witness; certificate deletionExcludesNecessaryConcrete, result 36c59929). Independent justification: the origin-tolerance account 5389a062 with an empty world c3f62370, or with origin-compatible deletion ed582cc8, derives worldwise deletion (results 1ca3d0d0 and 5ef604b9), a modal metaphysics of free recombination constrained only by origin essentialism. Relevance: it is the universal-contingency rival to every necessary-concretum route; argument d7c63935 derives from origin access and further premises that every possible world contains some individual (01243297), which bears on the empty-world variant. The attack does not decide between the two; it records that they cannot both hold at one world.
